title: Canonicalize provider-neutral FA3 Model Manager with StabilityMatrix as preferred current-host physical model-store provider
decisions: FA3 Model Manager is a provider-neutral logical inventory/lifecycle/artifact projection and does not replace StabilityMatrix model management.
StabilityMatrix remains the preferred current-host physical model store and distribution provider for model classes it natively supports.
Model identity is independent from filesystem path and provider store.
Provider metadata is an attributed claim until canonical validation succeeds.
Quantized, converted and optimized outputs are distinct artifacts with lineage.
Provider-native runtime stores may remain native when a verified shared-store projection is unavailable or inappropriate.
Physical deduplication is a separately authorized mutation and requires integrity, compatibility and rollback evidence.
Model routing, host-resource placement, secrets, policy and promotion remain owned by existing FA3 authorities.
User-confirmed StabilityMatrix usage does not constitute executable current-host production PASS evidence.
